criteria.full_n_service: Expose the complete C ingress stack as callable native operations. A c:: section in compiler/internal/catalogue/catalogue.json declares opaque artifact, invocation and token handles with five owner-leading operations (instrument, invoke_executable, invoke_case, observe, counters) matching the methods of CAdapterWitness in tools/runtime/test-services/native-values/c-witness.ts (922 lines). The checker learns an NT-I02 tag and an elision rule for witness handles owned by N, extending the NT-I01/NT-I11 line. The adapter in runtime/test-support/slices/i02/ combines c-ingress.ts (397 lines covering parseModule, checkModule and runtimeRootsOf) with the witness to call the authentic runEntry supervisor (runtime/entry.ts:61) and the authentic runAssertion supervisor (runtime/assert/runner.ts:146) using caller-furnished adapter functions, per-witness random nonces, and the K05 ceilings (MAX_WITNESS_ARTIFACTS 8, MAX_WITNESS_INVOCATIONS 32, MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES 1048576, MAX_WITNESS_ARGV 8). tests/native-can/src/capabilities/i02/ repeats the I01 pattern: sealed vocabularies (C_WITNESS_EXPORTS $canMain/$canCase; completed/rejected/failed outcomes), when-stub wrappers per operation, a composed instrument/invoke/observe scenario, and an example under tests/native-can/examples/capabilities/i02/. QN2 takes live-witness qualification; P14 still gates promotion.
criteria.inert_facts_only: Confine behavior to the host and publish inert records. The catalogue change to compiler/internal/catalogue/catalogue.json is restricted to record types for artifact facts (artifact id, adapter_export, adapter_binding, artifact_digest of sha256(path\0kind\0source), token, seq), observation facts (counter/identity payloads satisfying checkFactsInert) and witness counters (artifacts, invocations, completions, observations, rejected); it adds no operations, checker admissions or emitter mappings. The K04/K05 TypeScript (c-ingress.ts, c-witness.ts) shifts as-is into runtime/test-support/ under build acceptance, where the K04 19-check suite and the K05 29/29 suite persist as bun self-checks. tests/native-can/src/capabilities/i02/ constrains inert payloads to K05 vocabularies (allowed exports, outcome words, digest shape, cap limits) with fixture-derived rows, and the example exercises validation alone. Minimal catalogue churn; K04 seam reasoning never enters Can and live witnesses never meet candidate rows.
criteria.split_seam_can_witness_host: Publish pure seam reasoning while sheltering witness authority. Candidate-visible c:: catalogue operations check_module and parse_module take source text plus context (manifest view, EntryKind executable/assertion_root/assertion_case, module path, source) and yield parsed edges and problem strings, running merged c-ingress.ts inside runtime/test-support/slices/i02/ without witness powers, alongside inert fact records. The K05 CAdapterWitness (triples of token/id/digest minted as one, rejections covering bypass, mistaken exports, early reads and invented completions, callables from outside, random nonces, caps on artifacts and invocations) joins slices/i02/ purely as harness equipment: the QN2 harness alone operates it, candidate Can code cannot reach it, sustaining the K05 invariant that only triples created together authenticate. Can regains K04 verdicts as ported logic (the import grammar via text::regex_match.groups for captures; recursion in place of loops because str split does not exist), covers the 19 K04 checks with rows, checks inert witness facts, and offers a seam-validation example. The checker gains NT-I02 for the pure pair; witness liveness belongs to QN2; promotion awaits P14.

c_ingress_merge_shape.instructions: Decide how the K04 seam checker and K05 adapter witness should enter the sealed catalogue, admission checker, runtime adapter and ordinary Can code, respecting the I02 deliverable list (a catalogue.json change with an i02 Can package and example), the ban on candidates judging themselves, provisional status until P14 with live witness credit assigned to QN2, and Can strings that capture regex groups yet cannot split.

state: Two finished predecessors feed this merge. K04 settled the generated-C ingress seam in tools/runtime/test-services/native-values/c-ingress.ts (397 lines), c-ingress.manifest.json and c-ingress-check.ts, with 19 green ingress checks. It offers parseModule (IMPORT_PATTERN line matches plus export harvesting into an imports/exports/dynamicImport/body record), runtimeRootsOf (one common runtime root per closure) and checkModule (manifest, EntryKind executable/assertion_root/assertion_case, module path, source) emitting problem strings for dynamic import(), non-relative or root-escaping specifiers, off-seam resolutions, side-effect imports, bindings without aliases, locals missing the $can prefix, duplicate runtime roots, and entry-kind edge/body/export violations. Its manifest locks local_prefix $can, program roots program/assertions/packages, the runtime module catalog, and the fixed edges, body patterns and compulsory exports of every entry. K05 delivered the independent witness in tools/runtime/test-services/native-values/c-witness.ts (922 lines) plus c-witness-check.ts at 29/29. CAdapterWitness passes through the real runEntry supervisor (runtime/entry.ts:61, where exit 0/1 reads completed/failed) and the real runAssertion supervisor (runtime/assert/runner.ts:146, where pass, expected-evaluation-failed, and other outcomes read completed/rejected/failed), supplying the caller adapter plus a counting stub reporter. instrument() enforces closed-vocabulary exports (C_WITNESS_EXPORTS $canMain/$canCase), signatures identical to the manifest, and bytes the real K04 checker clears, before creating token/id/digest triples (cartifactN identifiers, sha256(path/kind/source) digests) where exclusively co-created triples authenticate. invokeExecutable/invokeCase log the invocation prior to awaiting (pending work shows yet stays unreadable) and settle from witnessed supervisor outcomes; observe() refuses unfamiliar ids, uninstrumented digests, concocted tokens and early reads; counters() counts artifacts/invocations/completions/observations/rejected. Ceilings read MAX_WITNESS_ARTIFACTS 8, MAX_WITNESS_INVOCATIONS 32, MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES 1048576, MAX_WITNESS_ARGV 8, MAX_WITNESS_ARGV_BYTES 256, MAX_WITNESS_PATH 256 at NATIVE_C_WITNESS_SCHEMA_VERSION 2. Leftovers: K01 outlaws eval so callables arrive from callers (QN2 live host must connect bytes with the callable), and assertion-root stdio resists hooking. Earlier merges I01 and I11 each sealed a catalogue namespace, led operations with the owner behind opaque handles, introduced an NT admission tag with scope elision, rested the adapter on the shared test owner, threaded an emitter fixture via the genuine checker, and released pure-Can validators, when-stub wrappers and a typed example provisionally ahead of P14. For Can text, text::compile_regex/text::matches produce text::regex_match values holding groups (str[]) and start/end positions; splitting, substring search and ordering are absent, leaving regex-plus-recursion as the porting route. I02 spans compiler/internal/catalogue/catalogue.json via cataloguegen, runtime/test-support/slices/i02/, evidence/I02.json, tests/native-can/src/capabilities/i02/ and tests/native-can/examples/capabilities/i02/. digestArtifact(path, kind, source) binds the artifact bytes.
